source_text: Observational studies and long-term follow-ups from the original randomized controlled trials (RCTs) conducted in Kenya, Uganda, and South Africa have corroborated the approximately 60% reduction in heterosexual HIV acquisition risk for men observed in the 2005–2007 trials. [12] [7]
